standard_prerequisites: Elementary distinguished squares and the exact sequences relating j_!, Rj_* and restriction to the two legs

core_obligations: Part (1): objects supported on T restrict to zero on U and on U x_X V, and the two exact sequences identify E with Rj_*(E|_V) and with j_!(E|_V)
Part (2): show j_!F and Rj_*F are supported on T and their restrictions to V are supported on j^{-1}T
Reduce the stalk check to the case where j has a section, by pulling back along V x_X V to V
Section case: split V into V' = sigma(X) and U' and use the distinguished triangles to compute j_!F and Rj_*F as sigma^*F
proof_roadmap: Prove part (1) directly from the two exact-sequence lemmas

Base change to the self product with a section to reduce the stalk verification
In the section case compute both pushforwards and check the restrictions agree
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a five-part isomorphism statement for j_! and Rj_* on objects supported away from the open leg of an elementary distinguished square (source lines 2134-2200, label lemma-pushforward-with-support-in-open). The solver must combine the exact-sequence triangles with a stalk-level reduction that replaces j by a morphism with a section, then compute both pushforwards through the decomposition V' amalgamated with U'; the section-reduction is a genuine descent trick, not a routine citation. Allowed background: the cited exactness and restriction lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
